text:
maria.g: Heads-up — SOC2 fieldwork just pinged for a couple of things: they want a small packet showing (1) RBAC change approvals for a recent service-account deprovision, (2) KMS key rotation evidence for the last 12 months, and (3) a sample incident triage that ties logs -> alert -> root cause -> remediation. Can we assemble?

sam.k: Yep. I can pull RBAC change records and the approval threads. Where do you want the KMS rotation artifacts from — console screenshots, rotation schedule CSV, or CloudTrail export?

maria.g: Prefer machine-readable exports + a short README. CloudTrail export + S3 presigned link is ideal. Include key IDs and rotation timestamps. Auditor asked for proof of automated rotation + manual rotations.

jen.l: For RBAC, I can export the org's rolebinding change events from the audit index. Quick note: we had the service-account deprov on 2024-08-21; approval flow was in Zendesk ticket #5231 and a small approval email chain. I'll include the ticket id and redacted emails.

sam.k: I'll add a Splunk/SIEM query that shows the rolebinding change and the initiating principal. Example query I used:
```spl
index=rbac_audit action=rolebinding_change object.kind=ServiceAccount | table _time, user, object_name, change_type, request_id
```
I'll also pull the KMS CloudTrail events: `CreateKey, ScheduleKeyDeletion, DisableKeyRotation, EnableKeyRotation, ReEncrypt` filtered by keyId.

maria.g: Nice. Auditor also wants a small simulated incident walkthrough that maps a hypothetical vulnerable deployment -> detection -> pager -> mitigation. It doesn't need to be a real incident but should show logs and timestamps, and that oncall followed the runbook. Can oncall-runner help with the runbook playback?

oncall-runner: I can simulate the transcript. I'll reference the incident runbook ID IR-2023-07 and include the timeline: detection at 14:02 UTC, pager at 14:05, mitigation steps executed 14:10-14:30, postmortem link. Will redact any customer data.

jen.l: For chain-of-custody on KMS rotation, include KMS rotation config export + HSM/KMS CMKs metadata. Ops-bot can we get the kms-rotation job history?

ops-bot: kms-rotation job history export ready at s3://redwood-compliance-temp/kms-rotation/rotation-history-2022-2025.csv (presigned link will be provided in the package). Note: file contains keyId, previousRotationDate, nextRotationDate, rotationActor (system/manual), rotationType.

sam.k: Two compliance-specific asks from the auditor: (A) mapping table of which controls map to which artifacts, and (B) a short narrative (~1 paragraph) that explains how automated rotation + CloudTrail meets the control requirement for key lifecycle. I'll draft both.

maria.g: Good call. Make the mapping explicit: e.g., CC6 (key lifecycle) -> CloudTrail export + rotation schedule CSV + KMS CMK policy. Also include screenshots of the KMS key policy that show least privilege.

jen.l: I'll package RBAC exports: rolebinding change events PDF, ticket screenshots, and the approval email redaction. Also, include a signed checklist verifying evidence chain.

sam.k: Quick vuln triage note: we discovered the container runtime CVE last month and performed mitigation. Auditor asked to see correlation between vuln triage ticket and incident timeline if applicable. I'll attach the vuln ticket and a one-line summary of remediation steps and verification scan results.

maria.g: Perfect. Can we get a small README.md inside the package that lists filenames, brief descriptions, and control mappings? Auditor prefers a single ZIP with a manifest.

oncall-runner: I'll perform a runbook replay capture (screenshots + timeline) and include the oncall ack log.

jen.l: One more: include the Splunk query we used with an example output CSV (sanitized). That helps auditors validate we can reproduce the evidence.

sam.k: Plan: assemble everything, generate presigned S3 link, create ZIP, attach manifest, and post to the auditor. Target: EOD tomorrow. Any objections?

maria.g: No objections. Assign owners: RBAC & approvals -> jen.l, KMS exports -> sam.k, Runbook replay -> oncall-runner, Packaging & manifest -> maria.g. I'll message legal for any extra redaction signoff.

jen.l: I'll start exporting now. Ping if you need the raw Splunk query or the ticket screenshots earlier.

sam.k: I'll generate CloudTrail export and rotation CSV, then share presigned link once the ZIP is ready.

maria.g: Thanks all. Auditor also asked one follow-up: can we include a short note on retention policy for the logs we handed over (where they live, retention period, and how to request extended retention)? I'll add that to the README.

ops-bot: Reminder: compliance packaging workflow created ticket COM-7192 and will auto-close when zip is uploaded to the release bucket.

maria.g: Great — closing loop here. If anything blocks owners, @maria.g will escalate. :thumbsup:
